# serverguard24_check (Resource)

Manages a Serverguard24 monitoring check.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "serverguard24_check" "http" {
  host_id   = serverguard24_host.web.id
  type      = "http"
  shortname = "HTTP"

  params {
    path    = "/"
    port    = 443
    timeout = 10
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host_id` (String) ID of the host this check belongs to.
- `type` (String) Check type. Valid values: `blacklist`, `cron`, `dns`, `domain`, `email`, `ftp`, `http`, `http_perf`, `imap`, `intranet`, `local`, `local_web`, `mongodb`, `mssql`, `mysql`, `ping`, `pop3`, `port_scan`, `postgresql`, `postman`, `selenium`, `site_perf`, `smtp`, `ssh`, `ssl_cert`, `system`, `tcp`, `transact_browser`, `transact_server`.

### Optional

- `active` (Boolean) Set to `false` to deactivate the check without deleting it. Defaults to `true`.
- `address` (String) Override address for this check.
- `description` (String) Description of this check.
- `email_critical` (Boolean) Send email on critical state.
- `email_ok` (Boolean) Send email on recovery.
- `email_remind` (Boolean) Send email reminders.
- `email_warning` (Boolean) Send email on warning state.
- `http_critical` (Boolean) Send HTTP hook on critical state.
- `http_ok` (Boolean) Send HTTP hook on recovery.
- `http_remind` (Boolean) Send HTTP hook reminders.
- `http_warning` (Boolean) Send HTTP hook on warning state.
- `interval` (Number) Check interval in minutes.
- `ipv6` (Boolean) Use IPv6.
- `message` (String) Custom notification message.
- `notification` (Boolean) Enable or disable alert notifications for this check. Defaults to `true`.
- `notify_after` (Number) Notify after N minutes of downtime.
- `params` (Block, Optional) Type-specific parameters. Valid attributes depend on the check type. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--params))
- `phone_critical` (Boolean) Send phone call on critical state.
- `phone_ok` (Boolean) Send phone call on recovery.
- `phone_remind` (Boolean) Send phone call reminders.
- `phone_warning` (Boolean) Send phone call on warning state.
- `push_critical` (Boolean) Send push on critical state.
- `push_ok` (Boolean) Send push on recovery.
- `push_remind` (Boolean) Send push reminders.
- `push_warning` (Boolean) Send push on warning state.
- `region` (String) Monitoring region. Valid values: `individual`, `europe`, `americas`, `europe_americas`, `asia_pacific`, `world`. Use `"individual"` to enable per-node selection (configure nodes in the Serverguard24 UI). Numeric IDs `0`–`5` are accepted for backwards compatibility.
- `reminder_interval` (Number) Reminder interval in hours.
- `shortname` (String) Short display name (max 40 characters).
- `sms_critical` (Boolean) Send SMS on critical state.
- `sms_ok` (Boolean) Send SMS on recovery.
- `sms_remind` (Boolean) Send SMS reminders.
- `sms_warning` (Boolean) Send SMS on warning state.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
